title: {Syn} Tokenization Decides What a Model Gets to See
content:
Language models process tokens rather than raw human words. A token may be a whole word, a word piece, punctuation, or part of a longer string.

Tokenization affects cost, multilingual behavior, code handling, and even which arithmetic or spelling tasks feel unnatural to a model.

Why it matters: ai papers keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
